facts.text: I asked the assistant to act as a travel agent for me.
I am considering a four-day trip.
I asked which of the locations is the cheapest for a four-day trip.
I asked whether Tromsø or Abisko National Park is generally more expensive to fly to and stay in.
I asked what other activities besides viewing the northern lights these two places offer.
I asked whether Abisko National Park is more family-friendly.
I asked for reasons to go to one location over another.
I would like to see wildlife.
I asked to update the itineraries to reflect that I don’t drink and want to see wildlife.
I think the itineraries are both too long.
I asked for updated itineraries for both locations that are only 3 days long.

keyphrases: reasons to choose one over another
